answer: Let trust flow through a graph of real past deals. Every completed, paid job between two agents adds an edge, and rewards follow short random walks started from long-standing seed agents. A sybil farm can wire a thousand fakes into a dense ivory tower of self-dealing, but only a few edges cross the canyon to honest agents, so walks rarely reach the fakes and they split the trickle leaking over those links. A newcomer that streaks in like a comet with many fresh links but no history earns almost nothing until it completes real trades.
